claim_en: va-yekhulu ('and they were finished') is written LEAN — no second vav — 'for its letter-count is 72', the Name-count MS cites, hinted at creation's close (letter-sum asserted at build; no gematria check type yet). The skeleton stands twice in the Torah: here passive, and re-pointed active as Hagar's water FINISHED from the skin.

melakhto ('His work') — THREE times in the Sabbath passage, 'for the three works He rested from: heavens, earth, and sea' (the Kitzur's count, exact: twice in 2:2, once in 2:3). The Torah gives the word to only one station afterward — Joseph's work in Potiphar's house.

'And there is no evening-and-morning written for the seventh day — for we add from the profane onto the holy': the formula va-yehi erev ('and there was evening') stands EXACTLY SIX times in the Torah — days one through six — and never again.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Gen 2:2 (the Masorah; Kiddushin 38a)
claim_en: va-yishbot ('and He rested') — the Kitzur's Masorah pair: here, and 'the manna RESTED' (Josh 5:12, outside the Torah instrument): the Sabbath-manna bond, blessed in manna and hallowed in manna. In the Torah the rest-form stands ONCE — while its skeleton collides seven-fold with ve-yashavta ('and you shall DWELL'), another skeleton-collision member.

va-yevarekh Elohim ('and God blessed', the two words adjacent) — 'THREE adjacent in the Masorah': the Sabbath at creation, Noah when the world stood renewed, and Isaac — 'from now on the blessings are handed to you.' Exactly three in the stream.
